# HELP nv_inference_request_success Number of successful inference requests, all batch sizes
# TYPE nv_inference_request_success counter
nv_inference_request_success{model="densenet_onnx",version="1"} 1000
nv_inference_request_success{model="resnet50",version="1"} 200
# HELP nv_inference_request_failure Number of failed inference requests, all batch sizes
# TYPE nv_inference_request_failure counter
nv_inference_request_failure{model="densenet_onnx",version="1",reason="REJECTED"} 0
nv_inference_request_failure{model="resnet50",version="1",reason="REJECTED"} 0
# HELP nv_inference_count Number of inferences performed (does not include cached requests)
# TYPE nv_inference_count counter
nv_inference_count{model="densenet_onnx",version="1"} 2000
nv_inference_count{model="resnet50",version="1"} 400
# HELP nv_inference_exec_count Number of model executions performed (does not include cached requests)
# TYPE nv_inference_exec_count counter
nv_inference_exec_count{model="densenet_onnx",version="1"} 400
nv_inference_exec_count{model="resnet50",version="1"} 100
# HELP nv_inference_request_duration_us Cumulative inference request duration in microseconds (includes cached requests)

nv_inference_request_duration_us{model="densenet_onnx",version="1"} 5000000
nv_inference_request_duration_us{model="resnet50",version="1"} 1000000

nv_inference_queue_duration_us{model="densenet_onnx",version="1"} 1000000
nv_inference_queue_duration_us{model="resnet50",version="1"} 100000

nv_inference_compute_infer_duration_us{model="densenet_onnx",version="1"} 3200000
nv_inference_compute_infer_duration_us{model="resnet50",version="1"} 700000
